templates.name: September Product Update
templates.subject: Introducing Relaybase Scale v2.0
templates.previewText: Broadcast stats, audience groups, and a calmer send pipeline
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

We just shipped **Relaybase Scale v2.0** — the first version built for teams who send product email from their own domain, not a shared marketing subdomain.

### What is new

* **Broadcast stats** — delivery, opens, clicks, and unsubscribes roll up per send without leaving the dashboard.

* **Audience groups** — link a list once; recipients are resolved at send time so late subscribers still receive scheduled mail.

* **Compliance footers** — CAN-SPAM blocks pull from a reusable sender identity instead of one-off copy/paste.

### Why it matters

If you have been stitching together spreadsheets, BCC tests, and manual unsubscribe replies, this release is meant to replace that loop with something you can audit.

Thanks for reading,\
 The Relaybase team

templates.name: July Recap
templates.subject: What shipped in July
templates.previewText: Deliverability tooling, faster inbox sync, and Scale groundwork
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

July was mostly infrastructure — the kind of work that does not show up in a screenshot but keeps mail landing in the inbox.

**Highlights**

1. **Domain onboarding** — clearer DNS checks and routing status in Console.

1. **Send logs** — dual-write to ops logs so failed API sends surface in the dashboard.

1. **CRM prototype** — audience + broadcast models landed behind the feature flag you are on.

We also fixed a handful of edge cases around partial bounces and local inbox delivery for `@relaybase.email` test addresses.

— Isaac & the Relaybase crew

templates.name: August Launch
templates.subject: Relaybase 2.0 is live
templates.previewText: Your domain, your keys, your broadcast pipeline
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

**Relaybase 2.0** is live for early access accounts. The headline change: everything runs on **your** Cloudflare Worker and verified domain — we do not sit in the SMTP path as a shared sender.

### Three things to try this week

* Send a **test broadcast** to your own `@relaybase.email` inbox.

* Rotate to a **domain-scoped API key** labeled for Scale sends.

* Open **Sent statistics** after a send and confirm rollups match the recipient list.

[Launch notes](https://relaybase.com/blog/v2) · [Watch the 8-minute demo](https://relaybase.com/demo)

If you hit a blocker, reply to this thread — we are actively pairing with design partners.

Cheers,\
 Relaybase

templates.name: Mid-August Security Note
templates.subject: Rotate your domain-scoped API keys
templates.previewText: A short security note for accounts using Scale send keys
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

We are asking all early Scale testers to **rotate domain-scoped API keys** this week.

**Why now**

* Scale stores a send key to call `POST /v1/send` on your Worker.

* Keys issued before August may have been copied into local dev stores or shared in screenshots.

**What to do**

1. Console → **API Keys** → revoke the old `CRM Broadcast` key if present.

1. Send a test mail from Scale — the app will issue a fresh key automatically.

1. Confirm the `from` address matches the key domain (`@relaybase.xyz`).

This takes about two minutes and prevents stale credentials from lingering in JSON fixtures.

Stay safe,\
 Relaybase Security

templates.name: September Welcome
templates.subject: Welcome to the product list
templates.previewText: What to expect from Product Updates and how to opt out
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Welcome, {{contact.name}} —

You are on **Product Updates**, our low-frequency list for release notes, beta invites, and occasional roadmap context. We typically send **once or twice a month**, never daily blasts.

**What you will get**

- Shipped features with enough detail to decide whether to turn them on.
- Links to docs — not vague marketing fluff.
- Clear unsubscribe on every message (one click, no login).

**What you will not get**

- Re-forwarded newsletters from other tools.
- Purchased lists or “growth hack” sequences.

While you are here, skim the [getting started guide](https://relaybase.com/docs/start) if you have not connected a domain yet.

Glad you are along for the ride,
Product team @ Relaybase

templates.name: Weekly Digest #36
templates.subject: Digest #36 — queue drain and rollups
templates.previewText: Scheduler batches, stat reconciliation, and a Scale send preview
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

**Weekly Digest #36** — a concise read for engineers following the Scale broadcast workstream.

### Shipped

* **Queue drain** — large audiences send in batches instead of blocking the HTTP request.

* **Stats rollup** — recipient ledger reconciles opens/clicks from tracking pixels.

* **Send credentials sync** — desktop app provisions a Worker key before dispatch.

### In progress

* List-Unsubscribe headers through `/v1/send`

* Webhook path for async bounces

### Worth your time

 

Reply if you want early access to the bounce webhook — we are testing with three design partners.

— Engineering updates

templates.name: Broken SMTP test
templates.subject: [Internal] Deliverability probe — do not forward
templates.previewText: Synthetic send used to validate SMTP error handling
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

This message is part of an **internal deliverability probe**. It intentionally exercises failure paths (invalid routes, key mismatch, or synthetic SMTP errors) so Scale can mark recipients as `failed` without affecting production stats.

**You can ignore this broadcast** unless you are actively debugging send pipelines.

If you received this in error, use the unsubscribe link — we will remove probe addresses from the Engineering list.

— Relaybase QA

templates.name: Weekly Engineering Digest
templates.subject: This week in platform engineering
templates.previewText: Worker send API, Scale dispatch, and inbox test accounts
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hey {{contact.name}},

Welcome to **Engineering Weekly** — a short note on what the platform team shipped and what is landing next.

**This week**

* Wired Scale `sendMail` to your Worker `POST /v1/send` with domain-scoped keys.

* Registered `@relaybase.email` mailboxes on the shared dev Worker for realistic inbox tests.

* Reset demo `store.json` fixtures to draft so you can re-run sends without seed noise.

**Next week**

* Public `SCALE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` for tracking pixels outside localhost.

* Bounce webhook ingestion from Worker events.

Questions? Drop a note in `#eng-relaybase` or reply here.

— Platform engineering

templates.name: Product Launch Wave
templates.subject: Wave 2 — onboarding checklist
templates.previewText: Five steps before your first real broadcast
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hi {{contact.name}},

You are in **Wave 2** of the Scale beta. Before you press **Send Now**, walk through this checklist:

1. **Verify domain** — Console shows `ready` for `relaybase.xyz`.
2. **Create a sender** — pick `hello@` or `jon@` on that domain.
3. **Compliance sender** — organization name + postal address filled in.
4. **Audience** — at least one active contact (your test inbox counts).
5. **Test send** — Publish tab → send to yourself; confirm HTML + footer.

[Open the onboarding checklist](https://relaybase.com/start)

Once green, duplicate this broadcast and send to the full Product Updates group.

Thanks for helping us harden the pipeline,
Customer success

templates.name: Partner note
templates.subject: A note for design partners
templates.previewText: How we want feedback during the Scale send beta
templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

Thank you for being a **design partner** on Relaybase Scale. This note sets expectations for the next two weeks of testing.

**We need from you**

* One **test send** and one **small real send** (≤10 recipients) with notes on anything confusing.

* Screenshots or Loom if the UI blocks you — especially Publish and Stats tabs.

* Honest feedback on copy, footers, and unsubscribe flow.

**We owe you**

* Same-day replies on blocking bugs during business hours (UTC+7).

* A written changelog when we flip List-Unsubscribe headers on the Worker.

No NDA beyond what you already agreed — feel free to talk about the experience, not other customers’ data.

Gratefully,\
 Isaac

templates.bodyMarkdown:
Hello {{contact.name}},

This is the **Engineering Weekly** template we use for internal send tests. It exercises merge tags, markdown links, and the built-in compliance footer.

### In this edition

- **Merge tags** — `{{contact.name}}` and `{{contact.email}}` resolve per recipient at send time.
- **Templates** — header logo and organization name come from template variables + compliance sender.
- **Tracking** — open pixel and wrapped links point at the Scale public base URL (set `SCALE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` for non-local tests).

Try clicking through to [Relaybase](https://relaybase.xyz) and confirm the redirect lands correctly.

If something looks off in Gmail or Apple Mail, forward the raw message — we are still tuning image guards and footer HTML.

Thanks,
Engineering Weekly editors

Your Relaybase account is live. Mail you send from here uses **your** verified domain and Worker — not a shared marketing subdomain.

1. Connect DNS for your sending domain if you have not already.
2. Create an audience group and import people who already opted in.
3. Send a test broadcast to your own inbox before you invite the team.

Glad you are here,  
The Relaybase team

### Make the trial count

1. Verify the sending domain you actually want to use in production.

1. Import one real audience (people who opted in), not a test dump.

1. Send a small broadcast and open **Sent statistics** — delivery, opens, and unsubscribes should match the recipient list.

Need a pairing session? Reply with two times.

— Relaybase
